scientific_integrity: Universal claims follow from explicit mathematical proofs and are checked against complete finite instances. The finite verifier is corroboration, not an infinite proof. Claims of exhaustive historical priority or independent validation are not made.
scientific_limitations: Fully occupied finite simple cycle, exactly two colors, symmetric half-peak utilities on closed neighborhoods, no tie-breaking, unrestricted pairwise swaps requiring both strict improvement, and degree-of-integration welfare. No extension to other topologies or action rules is claimed.
title: Exact equilibrium census and finite-population welfare on half-peaked Schelling rings
